offer: Recurring residential cleaning (weekly/biweekly/monthly) plus one-off deep cleans
how_it_makes_money: Per-clean or subscription pricing; margin between the client price and cleaner pay; revenue builds as recurring clients stay
startup_cost: low (amount not stated; mainly ads, booking software, insurance)
time_to_first_revenue: weeks; one operator reached $3-4k/month within about 6 months

how_it_makes_money: Low-ticket one-off sales and pre-orders; pass bar is 3+ strangers committing, ideally paying
startup_cost: low (a couple hundred dollars in tools at most)
time_to_first_revenue: a weekend to validate; pre-orders possible before building
evidence: Pass bar: 'at least three people you don't personally know take a real commitment step, ideally a payment or pre-order' (MyNXdDskh6c)
